question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Worn
solution: The correct answer is **"Dilapidated."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Worn"** means damaged and shabby as a result of much use. (अधिक उपयोग के परिणामस्वरूप क्षतिग्रस्त और जर्जर) • **Example**: *His knees were encased in **worn**__ plus fours.* • **"Dilapidated"** means in a state of disrepair or ruin. (जीर्णता या बर्बादी की स्थिति में) __ • **Example**: *The old house was so **dilapidated**__ that it was no longer habitable.* • The synonym of** "Worn"** is **"Dilapidated."** • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: Dilemma** means a difficult situation or problem. (दो या अधिक वस्तुओं में से एक का चयन करने की कठिन स्थिति, दुविधा, असमंजस) • **Option 2: Energetic** means having or showing great energy or vitality. (शक्ति व उमंग संपन्‍न, ऊर्जायुक्त, कर्मठ) • **Option 4: Diminutive** means extremely or unusually small. (सामान्‍य से काफ़ी छोटा, नन्‍हा) 3b:T76c, The correct answer is **"DEBCA."**
